scenarios.title: Another player can pay the generic part of a spell with assist
decisions: A considers casting Magma Hellion (cost {6}{R}), choosing B as the assisting player.
B taps six Forests for the generic mana, then A taps the Mountain for {R} (the verdict is read before the cast is made).

variants.label: six_untapped
variants.expected: Casting Magma Hellion is legal: B can pay all six generic mana and A pays {R}.

variants.label: five_untapped
variants.delta: One of B's Forests is tapped, so B has 5 untapped lands.
variants.expected: Casting Magma Hellion is not legal: B can pay at most 5 generic mana and A can pay only {R}, leaving {1} unpaid.

variants.label: no_red_source
variants.delta: A's land is a Plains instead of a Mountain.
variants.expected: Casting Magma Hellion is not legal: assist covers only generic mana, and neither A's Plains nor B's Forests can pay {R}.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge's can_play for the caster may not count the assisting player's lands; the verdict may need to be read from the assisted payment itself. In a two-player game the only possible assisting player is the opponent.
